statement.zh: 是否可将「孟斐斯」精确等同于某一尚未在本库登记现代专址总报的单一考古点，并据此给出未核对的城址坐标或出土清单——本库不采纳为既定事实；目前仅保留通论级政治中心取向。
statement.en: Whether “Memphis” can be precisely equated to a single archaeological point without a registered modern site monograph in this archive, and thereby assert unchecked city coordinates or find lists — not adopted as settled fact; only handbook-level political-center orientation is retained.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested precision label, not an established site-equation conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

editorial.notes: Separates conventional capital orientation (fact in other claims) from unsourced pinpointing.
